_comment_email: Send informational capital-needed alerts. Keep false until explicitly enabled.
_comment_email_to: Recipient for long-term trader alerts. Reusing the swing-trader alert inbox is okay.
_comment_email_from: Verified Brevo From address. This can match email_to.
_comment_email_username: Brevo SMTP login, for example abc123@smtp-brevo.com. Do not commit real credentials.
_comment_email_password: Brevo SMTP key, starts with xsmtpsib-. Do not commit real credentials.
